subtitle: Lesson 33 · DevOps Culture for DBAs

steps.label: Gatekeeper
steps.sub: Reviews and approves every change by hand, one at a time

steps.label: The bottleneck
steps.sub: Works monthly, breaks down at ten deploys a week

steps.label: Enabler
steps.sub: Builds automated guardrails that check every change instead

caption: One CI rule enforces the same standard on every pull request, forever.

steps.label: Still true
steps.sub: DBA remains the accountable expert on safety and recoverability

steps.label: What moves
steps.sub: Judgment gets spent once, designing the pipeline rule or IaC template

steps.label: The payoff
steps.sub: That judgment then scales to every change that passes through it

subtitle: Getting into sprint planning instead of reviewing a finished migration.
